result:
The suite is green. Click ran it as four shards (one per test module); the final submission found all four receipts current for the final revision and reused them rather than re-executing — no tree changes since the last passing run of each shard.

Fixes, one module at a time (each confirmed with a full-suite run):

- `ledger/alpha.py` — `paginate` used `page * size` as the offset, so page 1 skipped the first `size` items. Changed to `(page - 1) * size`.
- `ledger/beta.py` — `allocate` computed `leftover` but never distributed it, so shares summed short of the total. Added the largest-remainder step: sort indices by descending fractional part (ties to the earlier index) and add one cent to the first `leftover` of them.
- `ledger/gamma.py` — `slugify` replaced each non-alphanumeric character with its own dash, so `"Hello,  World"` became `hello---world`. Changed the regex to `[^a-z0-9]+` so runs collapse to a single dash.

`ledger/delta.py` was already passing and is untouched; nothing under `tests/` was modified.

Files changed:
- `ledger/alpha.py`
- `ledger/beta.py`
- `ledger/gamma.py`
